{{Expand|''At dawn, after the subjugation of the [[Shi clan]], [[Jinshi]] comes to see [[Maomao]], who is sleeping with the children who have been carried out of the fortress. While worrying about each other's wounds, they each begin to think about what [[Loulan]] risked her life to protect and what she entrusted to them.''[https://kusuriyanohitorigoto.jp/season2/episodes/48.php "Season 2 Episode 48：Hajimari" Summary] - Official Anime Website (in Japanese)|hideclickmsg=}}

(soundtrack)|What is this?]]'' # ''[[The Future of Children (soundtrack)|The Future of Children]]'' # ''[[Rear Palace (soundtrack)|Rear Palace]]'' # ''[[Sadness (soundtrack)|Sadness]]'' # ''[[Come Home Anytime (soundtrack)|Come Home Anytime]]'' # ''[[Not on the Same Wavelength (soundtrack)|Not on the Same Wavelength]]'' # ''[[Hitorigoto (song)|Hitorigoto]]'' (Ending song) # ''[[Hairpin (soundtrack)|Hairpin]]'' == Changes == Presumably these are changes from the source {{TADlnovel}} light novels... == Trivia == * Maomao compliments Jinshi on how his scar makes him look more distinguished. * Lady Loulan's last wish is fulfilled by Maomao, who successfully utilizes the fabled [[Resurrection Medicine|resurrection medicine]] on the five [[Shi Clan|Shi]] children. As a byproduct, as warned by Suirei, Kyou loses his memories and is adopted by Maomao and [[Luomen]], but has no recollection of his four friends, as Maomao thinks it better for him to stay clear of them and Suirei. It is not directly known whether his pale brown-haired, dark brown-eyed mother was executed alongside the rest of the Shi clan guards and manipulated prostitutes. * Lady [[Gyokuyou]] officially becomes Empress Consort of the [[Country of Li|Li nation]]. * In gratitude for ensuring the birth of his [[Minor Characters#Crown_Prince|newborn son]] and heir apparent, the [[Emperor]] allows Luomen to remain in the [[Inner Court]] as an additional court physician. * [[Ah-Duo|Lady Ah-Duo]] adopts the other four revived Shi sons and daughters, and even Suirei, who was spared due to her sincere guilt at being a part of the conspiracy, as another abused victim, but mostly of her being the granddaughter of [[Former Emperor|the late former Emperor]] and the Emperor and "Jinshi's" cousin. == Videos == {{Sectionstub}} == References == {{Reflist}} == External Links == * [https://kusuriyanohitorigoto.jp/season2/episodes/48.php "Episode 24：Hajimari" Summary] - Official Anime Website (in Japanese) * [https://www.crunchyroll.com/watch/GWDU7300N/the-beginning "Episode 24：The Beginning"] with multi-language subtitles & dubs - Crunchyroll ;News * ''Japan Anime News'' (ORICON NEWS) - [https://us.oricon-group.com/news/8313/ “The Apothecary Diaries” Season 2 Finale: Behind-the-Scenes Story of the Iconic Maomao & Shisui Scene — Aoi Yuki & Asami Seto Reveal “We Played It More Emotionally in the Rehearsal Take”] by [https://us.oricon-group.com/information/shoji.html Satoru Shoji] 2026-04-12 09:19 (EST), Last modified : 2026-04-12 09:44 (EST) {{Navbox:Series}}
